# German Performance

> Independent German auto repair in Snellville, Georgia (Gwinnett County),
> family-owned since 2010. BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Porsche and Volkswagen
> only, diagnosed on each manufacturer's own factory software (ISTA,
> XENTRY, ODIS, PIWIS). Written estimate before any work; 12-month /
> 12,000-mile warranty. 2144 Parkwood Rd NW, Snellville, GA 30078.
> (678) 395-7459. Monday-Friday 9:30 AM-6:00 PM.

Serves Snellville, Loganville, Grayson, Lawrenceville, Stone Mountain and
the rest of Gwinnett County. CARFAX 2025 Top-Rated Service Center, 4.8 stars
on CARFAX, 180+ Google reviews.

## Makes

- [BMW repair](https://germanperformancega.com/bmw-repair-snellville-ga): Brand hub: what the shop sees on that marque, every service it performs on it, and its guides
  - [BMW Maintenance Schedule Explained](https://germanperformancega.com/bmw-maintenance-schedule-explained): How Condition Based Service counts, which oil approval your engine needs, and where we shorten BMW's own intervals and why.
  - [BMW Drivetrain Malfunction Explained](https://germanperformancega.com/bmw-drivetrain-malfunction-explained): What the message means, the causes we see by engine family, and the order we test in before anything is replaced.
  - [Why BMW Repair Costs What It Does](https://germanperformancega.com/why-bmw-repair-costs-what-it-does): Parts tiers, labor that is really about access, the coding that finishes the job, and why BMW jobs cluster. No prices.
  - [BMW Repair Case Studies](https://germanperformancega.com/bmw-repair-case-studies): Three representative jobs from our bays: an N20 cold-start rattle, an N55 burning smell, and an X5 that sat low overnight.
- [Mercedes-Benz repair](https://germanperformancega.com/mercedes-repair-snellville-ga): Brand hub: what the shop sees on that marque, every service it performs on it, and its guides
  - [Mercedes Service A vs Service B](https://germanperformancega.com/mercedes-service-a-vs-service-b): What ASSYST Plus counts, what each service actually includes, the oil sheet your engine needs, and what we inspect that the sheet does not list.
  - [Mercedes AIRMATIC Problems Explained](https://germanperformancega.com/mercedes-airmatic-problems-symptoms-diagnosis): Why a Mercedes sits low on one corner, which component is at fault, and how XENTRY and a fill test tell a strut from a compressor.
  - [Why Mercedes Repair Costs What It Does](https://germanperformancega.com/why-mercedes-repair-costs-what-it-does): Genuine vs OE-supplier parts, sealed assemblies, access labor, the XENTRY factor and whole-assembly quotes for repairable faults. No prices.
  - [Mercedes Repair Case Studies](https://germanperformancega.com/mercedes-repair-case-studies): Three representative jobs: an M272 oil smell with coolant loss, a GL450 low on one corner, and a 722.9 in limp mode that did not need a transmission.
